rows.title: Energy review of the process
rows.basis: the review covers the P2O5-normalised energy of every area

rows.title: Energy performance indicator
rows.basis: specific energy against the registered design value

rows.title: Baseline data quality
rows.basis: at least 98 % of the intervals of the historian usable

rows.title: Objectives and targets
rows.basis: the share of the registered targets that are met

rows.title: Operational control
rows.basis: no open critical finding on the operating window

rows.title: Monitoring and measurement
rows.basis: the instrument register of the twin

rows.title: Significant environmental aspects
rows.basis: fluorine at the stack is the significant aspect of the acid plant

rows.title: Emissions monitoring
rows.basis: particulate at the stack of the granulation plant

rows.title: Waste management
rows.basis: the phosphogypsum leaves the plant with less than 1 % free P2O5

rows.title: Water balance and discharge
rows.basis: process water per tonne of P2O5

rows.title: Emergency preparedness
rows.basis: the scrubber pH is the first barrier of the fluorine release

rows.title: Water use review
rows.basis: every significant water use is accounted for

rows.title: Water reuse
rows.basis: recovered process water over the water the plant moves

rows.title: Effluent quality
rows.basis: the effluent pH stays inside the discharge range

rows.title: Product specification
rows.basis: DAP 18-46-0, nitrogen of the bagged product

rows.title: Product moisture
rows.basis: the moisture that keeps the product free flowing

rows.title: Product solubility
rows.basis: water-soluble P2O5 of the product

rows.title: Control of production
rows.basis: the merchant acid leaves the evaporators at specification

rows.title: Merchant acid specification
rows.basis: the sulphate of the merchant acid is the first limit of the traded grade

rows.title: Fluorine of the merchant acid
rows.basis: fluorine above the specification corrodes the storage and the customer's plant

rows.title: Solids of the merchant acid
rows.basis: the fines the filters let through settle in the storage tanks

rows.title: Yield of the acid route
rows.basis: the P2O5 that reaches the filters over the P2O5 fed to the attack

rows.title: Scope 1 quantification
rows.basis: the fuel of the dryers, the calcination CO2 and the sulphur burnt

rows.title: Scope 2 quantification
rows.basis: the grid electricity of the mine and the plant

rows.title: Emissions intensity
rows.basis: kgCO2e per tonne of P2O5 produced

rows.title: Emission factor register
rows.basis: every factor is registered with its source

rows.title: BAT emission levels
rows.basis: the BAT range of the fluorine emitted by the acid plant

rows.title: Energy efficiency of BAT
rows.basis: the energy consumption of the BAT reference document

rows.title: Continuous monitoring
rows.basis: the monitoring of the emission points is continuous and usable

rows.title: Waste management plan
rows.basis: the phosphogypsum is managed inside the permitted facility

rows.title: Fluoride emission limit
rows.basis: the fluoride standard of the phosphoric acid subpart

rows.title: Scrubber operating limit
rows.basis: the parameter that has to stay inside its operating range

rows.title: Record keeping
rows.basis: the records of the emission point are complete for the period

rows.title: P2O5 recovery of the route
rows.basis: the recovery from the mine to the bagged product

rows.title: Specific acid demand
rows.basis: sulphuric acid per tonne of P2O5

rows.title: Steam of the acid concentration
rows.basis: steam per tonne of P2O5 concentrated: the largest energy item of the acid route

rows.title: Water-soluble loss
rows.basis: the P2O5 lost with the gypsum

rows.title: Fluorine recovery
rows.basis: the fluorine recovered as fluosilicic acid

rows.title: Liberation of the ore
rows.basis: the grind that liberates the apatite of the blend

rows.title: Gypsum quality to the stack
rows.basis: the free P2O5 of the cake going to the stack

rows.title: Water return to the plant
rows.basis: the water recovered from the stack pond

rows.title: Dust control on the stack
rows.basis: the dust of the gypsum handling
